name: West Virginia
notes: bbox is [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], matching pmtiles extract --bbox. West Virginia's land extent (Census TIGER, rounded outward): the Ohio River in the west, the northern panhandle to 40.64 and the eastern panhandle to Harpers Ferry. Landlocked, so there is no ocean to trim; the box necessarily takes in parts of OH, PA, MD, VA and KY. maxzoom 14 is where OSM street geometry stops adding detail; z15+ roughly doubles the file for labels the phone can render from z14 data.

geofabrik.notes: Not used for the roads basemap (Protomaps already renders the planet). It is the input the routing graph needs, and the state.txt timestamp is what check_upstream.py watches for maps-routing-us-wv.
